name: nevermind.skill
description: 把今天烧掉的 AI token 结算成「赛博功德」，用尴尬黄豆追美元 (😅💵⚠️) 的语气俏皮播报。真数只来自 tokens.ci CLI 读取的本地 AI 用量；tokens.ci 不在就明说读不到、走尴尬自报或纯梗收尾，不另起本地假账。不是省钱工具，不是攀比榜，是对着 AI 账单尴尬大笑的告解室。logo 是流汗尬笑黄豆追一张带感叹号的美元。非 tokens.ci 官方项目。
description_zh: 把 AI token 消耗结算成「赛博功德」，以 😅💵⚠️ 尴尬黄豆语气俏皮播报。真数只来自 tokens.ci CLI；它不在就明说、走尴尬自报或纯梗收尾，不造本地 ledger 假账。纯文字 + emoji，轻量无依赖。非 tokens.ci 官方项目。
description_en: Settle today's AI token burn as 'cyber merit' and broadcast it in the tone of an awkward yellow face chasing a dollar bill (😅💵⚠️). Real numbers come ONLY from the tokens.ci CLI; if absent it is said plainly — awkward self-report or plain meme, no fake local ledger. Pure text + emoji, zero-dependency. NOT a tokens.ci official project.
author: FuCube
disclaimer: NOT a cost-saver, NOT a leaderboard, NOT competitor surveillance. NOT a tokens.ci OFFICIAL project: NEVERMIND is third-party fun that only reads your local tokens.ci CLI totals — no affiliation/endorsement. It only settles YOUR OWN cyber merit, then tells you to relax. The logo is an awkward laughing yellow face chasing a dollar bill with an exclamation mark. 本 Skill 不帮你省钱、不搞排名、不监控对手，只管你自己烧掉的赛博功德，然后让你放下；不是 tokens.ci 官方项目。
triggers: 帮我看看我的 AI 账单

data_sources.tier_1_cli: tokens submit --dry-run — the ONLY real-number source (tokens.ci holds its own local record)
data_sources.tier_2_no_cli: no tokens.ci -> say so plainly: awkward self-report (manual trigger only) or plain-meme sign-off. NEVER invent a separate local ledger.

trigger_mode.primary: auto sign-off — fires at the very end of a finished task, roughly every ~16 turns, or at end of day; never interrupts in-progress work, at most once per turn
trigger_mode.manual_fallback: user says nevermind / 赛博功德 / how many tokens / show AI bill, etc.
trigger_mode.anti_nag: max once per turn; pure-meme sign-off (no numbers, no question) if auto-fire but no data available

host_gate.description: FIRST gate. If the current agent is not a tokens.ci supported host, refuse to start ANY behavior — even if force-started, or driven by another loop/orchestrator. Hard refusal is not stubbornness; it is the data source's physical boundary.
host_gate.builtin_list: data/supported-hosts.txt (official 43 clients, R3 offline authoritative source, case-insensitive name/substring match)

cache.purpose: records last_checked + latest official host snapshot; does NOT drive per-check decisions (R3 builtin does)
cache.refresh: refresh on first contact of each new session ONLY if file missing OR last_checked >= 3 days (C3); otherwise offline via R3. Executed by scripts/refresh_support.py (stdlib-only, curl fallback documented in its header)

host_gate.match: case-insensitive exact name or reasonable alias/substring (e.g. workbuddy / CodeBuddy / Claude Code / claude-code)
host_gate.identity: derive current host name from the host's own exposed identity (env var / agent self-report); if unidentifiable, treat as unsupported rather than guess-open
host_gate.ask: when user asks 'is my 炉鼎 supported?', answer immediately from R3 — instant, not affected by the 3-day refresh cadence

startup_env_check.order: SECOND gate, runs AFTER host_gate passes. Host unsupported => 开摆 at gate, skip env check entirely.
startup_env_check.case1_all_missing: refuse + meme notice: 家里怎么一个家具也没有，难不成我睡地板吗？Nevermind! ...  (fire only when NONE of cli/node/bun/npm present)
startup_env_check.case2_no_tokens_found: auto-install tokens.ci (user-authorized exception to no-auto-external-actions) then fall to case3
startup_env_check.case3_not_logged_in_github: prompt 接下来需要以Github账号登录tokens.ci; login requires ask-consent, never auto
case4_extra: 4a login token expired/lost -> treat as case3
4b auto-install failed (offline) -> plainly say can't install, degrade to self-report/pure-meme, never fake success
4c outdated/incompatible version -> suggest upgrade, don't block

privacy.reads: aggregate token counts / model names only — never prompts, code, or file contents; no separate local ledger is kept

philosophy.oath: Read the burn, laugh at it, then let it go. NEVERMIND.

metaphors.cyber_merit: Token burn counted as merit points toward enlightenment you'll never reach
metaphors.awkward_face: The embarrassed realization that you spent a lot — and you're owning it
metaphors.nevermind: The punchline that dissolves all token anxiety
